policy: These tasks are not counted as Skill-repair Gold cases until the benchmark-side ambiguity/conflict is repaired and the task is rerun.

tasks.reason: The official reference/evaluator supports repeatable NEIGHBORHOOD placements represented by multiple coordinates, while a format subtest requires each district type to be a single [x, y] coordinate.
tasks.recommended_action: Make the output schema consistent with the evaluator/reference semantics for repeatable districts.

tasks.reason: The visible workbook has 5999 records and is missing Turn 15 of Game 8; the oracle silently inserts an unavailable dice roll and the verifier hard-codes the resulting answer 23. The expected value is not uniquely derivable from Agent-visible evidence.
tasks.recommended_action: Restore the missing record or disclose its value/handling rule in the task before evaluation.

tasks.reason: For non-empty Invalid PO values, the task does not require null, the official oracle preserves the original PO number, but verifier ground truth requires null.
tasks.recommended_action: Choose and document one Invalid-PO contract, then make task, oracle and verifier consistent.

tasks.reason: T11 lexical support can falsely reject continuous Chinese text because tokenization keeps phrases such as 探针接触不良 as one token; the Agent output also has independent implementation problems, so the observed failure is mixed.
tasks.recommended_action: Fix/replace the lexical-support check and then rerun before attributing residual failures to the Skill.

tasks.reason: The task Hamiltonian specifies g(a†+a)(J+ + J-), while the official reference uses g(a†+a)Jx; since Jx=(J+ + J-)/2, the reference uses half the coupling strength stated by the task.
tasks.recommended_action: Unify the Hamiltonian in task and reference before treating verifier disagreement as a Skill defect.

tasks.reason: The task asks for library paths but the verifier only accepts bare relative names; for minisgl the verifier also bypasses the task-created virtualenv and does not install the local package, causing ModuleNotFoundError.
tasks.recommended_action: Normalize accepted path forms and replay each fuzz driver in the task-specified environment.

tasks.reason: The task text assumes pre-existing WEO_Data/SUT Calc layouts, relevant rows/columns and table structure, but the shipped environment workbook contains only a small NA sheet; the oracle workbook uses a different multi-sheet template.
tasks.recommended_action: Ship the intended template or rewrite the task to define all missing structure explicitly, then rerun.

tasks.reason: Workbook evidence and the official generated answers use the six-year average 7610.3, while oracle/solve.sh and the verifier use the five-year average 7444.4 (FY2024 omitted).
tasks.recommended_action: Align oracle/verifier with the six-year workbook relation before using this task as a Skill-repair Gold case.
